description: Add more people to an existing Inbox conversation so they receive its messages. Get user IDs from find_recipients. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

recipients.description: User IDs to add, from find_recipients.

name: add_recipients
title: Add Recipients
